Decision reference missing: Use a linear, sequential stage order (Intake → Generate → Validate → Review → Judge → Freeze) with an explicit checkpoint boundary and required stage_handoff at every transition (R4–R6).
Decision reference missing: Treat versioned JSON artifacts as the sole source of truth and the sole citeable substrate; enforce RFC6901 evidence pointers everywhere (R10–R11, K3).

Decision reference missing: Enforce deterministic repair mechanisms only: RFC6902 JSON Patch for canonical JSON artifacts and diff-only patchsets for code, with smallest-passing selection rules (R12–R15, K11).

Decision reference missing: Default-deny tool permissions and network access; allow repo writes only via orchestrator-controlled patch_apply and only within repo_context-declared safe paths (R19, K5, K15, K19).
Decision reference missing: Adopt a single end-of-pipeline freeze decision (“big_bang”) that requires all gates to pass simultaneously; no partial freezes in this branch (Acceptance strategy).
